request: The viewer is very slow. Lines must connect parts to their corresponding sidebar section, not floating tags. Organize the sidebar so every part/section stays visible, even with details collapsed.
scope: Viewer interaction/performance, current English guides and existing main/Pages publication. Preserve native CAD, configuration schema, catalog and exact GLB/offline behavior.
acceptance: No floating tags; active visible component connects directly to its own sidebar anchor
All12 component names and View/Files/About/collapse controls remain unclipped while details scroll or collapse
390x844 and320x568 touch layouts plus844x390 landscape and1440x960 desktop
Preserve mouse, keyboard, touch, six one-click frame previews, per-half settings, JSON and exact GLB geometry/materials
Same-browser CPU-throttled baseline/current measurement: p95 orbit interval improves at least35% and long-task time at least65%
Public HTML, current source and functional browser test verified

review.agreement: Bounded viewer-only correction; persistent component directory with separate details and no surface searching during orbit.

dispositions.finding: Up to192 full-scene surface queries per camera update; current cache invalidated by camera/hover.
dispositions.resolution: One coalesced render per frame; no anchor search during gestures. One active surface is resolved after settling, with bounding-box broad phase and closest-hit early exit.

dispositions.finding: Exclusive tabs and floating tags do not link parts to persistent sidebar entries.
dispositions.resolution: Permanent12-component directory and stable section controls; details can collapse/scroll independently. SVG endpoint comes from the corresponding entry rect.

dispositions.finding: Mobile cannot fit12 full-height vertical rows plus the model.
dispositions.resolution: Compact4-column mobile grid; actual rectangle/text/hit-target checks at320/390px, plus short landscape layout.

dispositions.finding: Per-frame allocation, DOM churn and duplicate rendering.
dispositions.resolution: Reuse highlight meshes, cache world bounds by geometry revision, update active-row state only when changed and schedule one render with requestAnimationFrame.

dispositions.finding: Prior checks proved function but not latency or literal sidebar visibility.
dispositions.resolution: Before/after performance script plus all-entry clipping, exact sidebar endpoints, collapse/scroll/resize and preserved export tests.

retrospective.trigger: User reported severe slowness and clarified that lines should target the sidebar.
retrospective.cause: Measured old orbit cost disappeared when its floating labels were disabled. Source recomputed multi-group intersection searches synchronously during every camera movement. Prior UI tests did not measure latency or endpoint intent.
retrospective.prevention: Keep a reproducible latency comparison and exact sidebar-destination/visibility checks; preserve the original meshes.
